measures.what: body length and width below the mounting tabs (and whether the wire grommet sticks out past the body below the tabs)
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo rib width: 1.51 mm (a rib on each tab's top face (the shaft side), between the tab's two holes; it stops the tabs sitting flush); servo rib height: 1.8 mm (how far the rib stands up from the tab's top face); servo rib position: 8.31 mm (from the side of the holes to the middle of the rib); servo cable exit: out of one end of the case, below the tabs (where the cable leaves; I didn't measure its size or how far it sticks out)
